loc-1765877487336-nfrgwat5f.name: The Shadowlands

dna.looks: AERIAL/SATELLITE VIEW: A vast, desolate expanse of shadowed plains and skeletal forests stretching to a featureless horizon. Distant, jagged mountain ranges pierce the oppressive grey sky like broken teeth. No individual structures are discernible, only the oppressive sweep of the land.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Dominated by muted, desaturated tones of deep grey, bruised purple, and faded ochre. Light is weak and diffused, casting long, indistinct shadows.
dna.atmosphere: A heavy, suffocating stillness hangs in the air, broken only by the occasional mournful whisper of unseen winds. The air is thick with a palpable sense of melancholy and unease.
dna.materials: Predominantly appears as vast, uneven expanses of dark, cracked earth and stunted, skeletal trees. Jagged rock formations are visible in the far distance.
dna.mood: Overwhelmingly melancholic, foreboding, and spiritually oppressive. A sense of profound loss and eternal decay pervades the entire realm.
dna.sounds: Distant, faint whispers, the sighing of wind through unseen skeletal branches, and a low, pervasive hum of spiritual unrest.
dna.primary_surfaces: Vast, cracked earth plains and the skeletal canopy of dying forests.
dna.secondary_surfaces: Distant, jagged mountain ranges and stagnant, dark pools of water.
dna.accent_features: None discernible from this scale; the land itself is the overwhelming feature.
dna.ambient: Weak, diffused grey light filtering through a perpetual overcast sky.

loc-1765877487336-nfrgwat5f.description: A realm shrouded in perpetual twilight, where ancient spirits linger and the veil between worlds is thin. Mist perpetually clings to the desolate landscape, obscuring distant, melancholic vistas.
loc-1765877487336-nfrgwat5f.searchDesc: Realm of lingering spirits, perpetual twilight, and thin veils.

structure.spatialLayout: Expansive and featureless, with a sense of unending desolation. The landscape stretches infinitely towards a blurred, indistinct horizon.

22d40676-13ed-4c73-85cf-bd731b47163b.name: Blackwood Manor

dna.looks: A towering, three-story Victorian structure with steeply pitched gables and ornate, but decaying, gingerbread trim. The overall shape is rectangular with protruding bay windows and a prominent central gable. Scale is imposing and designed to intimidate.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Predominantly muted greys and browns of weathered wood and stone, punctuated by the stark black of broken glass. Light struggles to penetrate the dense foliage and shattered panes, creating deep shadows.
dna.atmosphere: The air hangs heavy and still, carrying the damp scent of decay and wet earth. A palpable chill emanates from the manor, even on a clear day. A faint, almost imperceptible breeze rustles the dead leaves.
dna.materials: Primarily dark, weathered wood siding, crumbling brick foundations, and rusted ironwork. Textures are rough, splintered, and slick with moss and dampness.
dna.mood: The manor evokes a sense of dread, melancholy, and foreboding. It feels like a place where secrets fester and time has long since stopped.
dna.sounds: Creaking wood, rustling leaves, distant wind, faint echoes
dna.primary_surfaces: weathered wooden siding, cracked brick walls, shattered glass panes
dna.secondary_surfaces: overgrown ivy, decaying shingles, rusted iron railings
dna.accent_features: ornate gingerbread trim, a gargoyle, a rusted weather vane
dna.architectural_tone: dilapidated Victorian Gothic with elements of decay
dna.cultural_tone: Abandoned residence, once belonging to wealthy but now forgotten inhabitants.
dna.palette_bias: cool desaturated tones, dark earth tones
dna.flora_base: gnarled trees, dead bushes, thick ivy

22d40676-13ed-4c73-85cf-bd731b47163b.description: An imposing, dilapidated Victorian mansion with broken windows and overgrown gardens. EXTERIOR VIEW.
22d40676-13ed-4c73-85cf-bd731b47163b.searchDesc: An imposing, dilapidated Victorian mansion with broken windows and overgrown gardens.

structure.spatialLayout: The facade presents a deep, shadowed entry framed by imposing walls. The interior space is implied to be vast and echoing, with a sense of great depth behind the broken facade.

uniqueIdentifiers: a single, ornate, but rusted weather vane

niche-1765877533709-x8tw0egsu.name: Grand Hall

dna.looks: A vast, high-ceilinged hall, dimly lit, with the echoes of former opulence now choked by dust and decay. Cobwebs drape like macabre decorations from ornate fixtures and cracked plaster.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Deep, desaturated shadows dominate, punctuated by weak shafts of dusty light filtering through grimy, leaded windows. The palette is a symphony of muted greys, deep browns, and the occasional dull gleam of tarnished metal.
dna.atmosphere: Heavy, stagnant air, cool and damp, carrying the faint scent of mildew and age. A profound stillness pervades, broken only by the creaks and groans of the old house.
dna.materials: Cracked plaster walls, dark stained wood paneling, wrought iron fixtures, dusty velvet draperies, and stone flagging.
dna.mood: Melancholy, foreboding, and lonely. A sense of grandeur lost and forgotten.
dna.sounds: Creaking wood, dripping water, distant wind, faint whispers of the past.
dna.spatialLayout: A grand, rectangular hall with a high ceiling, featuring a central void leading to a prominent staircase at the rear.
dna.primary_surfaces: Cracked plaster, dark wood paneling, rough stone floor
dna.secondary_surfaces: Dusty velvet, tarnished brass, cobweb-laden wood trim
dna.accent_features: Faded tapestries, ornate but broken chandelier, skeletal furniture covered in sheets
dna.cultural_tone: Abandoned residence, once belonging to wealthy but now forgotten inhabitants.
dna.palette_bias: cool desaturated tones, dark earth tones
dna.flora_base: gnarled trees, dead bushes, thick ivy

niche-1765877533709-x8tw0egsu.description: The main hall of Blackwood Manor, a vast space that speaks of former grandeur, now muted by neglect.

structure.spatialLayout: A cavernous hall with high, vaulted ceilings. Faded tapestries hang from the walls, and a grand, but dust-covered, staircase dominates one end.
